title: ALMA [{N} {II}] 205 μm Imaging Spectroscopy of the Lensed Submillimeter Galaxy ID 141 at Redshift 4.24
question: What are the intrinsic morphology, kinematics, line ratios and star formation properties of the lensed SMG ID 141, from ALMA [N II] 205 um and continuum imaging?

data.sensitivity: continuum rms 0.25 mJy/beam; cube rms ~0.6 mJy/beam per 100 km/s channel

what.value: [C II] flux 107±17 Jy km/s and CO(7-6) flux 6.5±1.4 Jy km/s

evidence.quote: together with the \[C ii \] flux ($107\pm 17$ Jy km/s) and CO (7-6) flux ($6.5\pm1.4$ Jy km/s) from (cite: Cox2011)

what.value: Lens configuration: two lens galaxies at z=0.595; Keck astrometry for secondary lens offset

evidence.quote: using the astrometry information provided by Keck image (cite: Bussmann2012)

recipe.method: CASA cleaning with natural weighting, uvcontsub order 1; continuum averaged over three SPWs
polygon apertures on each lensed image; double-Gaussian fits
modified blackbody fit with beta fixed

recipe.goal: Lens model the continuum in the uv-plane
recipe.method: two SIE lenses plus one Sérsic source; visibility fitting with nested sampling
assumptions: single Sérsic source; lens mass ratio not fixed

recipe.method: trace [N II] moment maps to source plane with the continuum lens model, stacking multiple image counterparts weighted by flux
assumptions: beam smearing not accounted for; qualitative

recipe.goal: Line ratios, SFR and SF region size
recipe.method: line ratios vs C(60/100) from Lu2015; SFR from LIR (Kennicutt) and CO(7-6); Sigma_SFR from C(60/100); R_SF from Sigma_SFR = 0.5 SFR/(pi R^2)

evidence.quote: The total \[N ii \] flux is $7.9\pm 1.9$ Jy km/s.
The total continuum flux measured by ALMA is 52.0 $\pm$ 5.2 mJy.
The best-fit model has $\chi^2 = 757972$ with 746981 degrees of freedom
The resulting dust temperature is $\sim$40 K.

not_stated_but_needed: Clean threshold, cell and image size
Which SPWs/channels and mask define the moment maps
Details of moment-map back-projection to source plane
Exact visibility data selection/averaging for lens modelling
missing_for_reproduction: Imaging parameters (cell, image size, line-free channels)
score_reason: Public data and public code, and lens priors tabulated, but imaging and kinematic reconstruction details are sparse.
rediscovery_reason: Public single-EB data, numeric results (fluxes, lens parameters), code available.
